subject: Graphical Software Developer Opening at Viridien
body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology, and I reached out about the Graphical Software Developer opening at Viridien, posted for a while now, and was not sure if it is still active.

The role centers on native desktop tools for visualizing three dimensional subsurface data through a Qt based interface, which lines up with recent work of mine. I built a desktop application in PySide6 with an OpenGL backed viewport for visualizing coordinate frame transforms and wrote the spatial math engine myself. I also optimized custom CUDA kernels in C and C++, and worked with PyQt during an internship on a real time data visualization tool.

If the role is still open I would welcome hearing more, and if someone else on your team is closer to this req I would appreciate being pointed their way.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
